claim: Across 12 trials of guided tissue regeneration with 20 defects each, deeper disease means larger gain: the mean over trials of the within-trial regression slope of the change in attachment loss (follow-up minus baseline) on the mean of the baseline and follow-up attachment loss is at most -0.20 (mm per mm).

data_keys.meaning: clinical attachment loss of each defect in each trial at the baseline examination, in mm
a second, independent measurement of the attachment loss of each defect at the baseline examination, in mm
clinical attachment loss of each defect at the follow-up examination after treatment, in mm

claim: Among 400 adult beetles measured on six skeletal dimensions, the dimensions share a common shape pattern beyond body length: after removing the linear effect of body length from each of the six dimensions, the first principal component of their covariance matrix explains at least 40% of the total variance.

data_keys.meaning: six linear skeletal dimensions of each specimen, in mm
body length of each specimen, in mm

claim: The 25 measurements in X predict the outcome y for new samples: the mean absolute error of an ordinary least squares regression of y on X (with an intercept) is at least 10% below that of predicting the mean of y: 1 - MAE(model) / MAE(mean predictor) >= 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: 25 continuous measurements for each sample
continuous outcome of each sample

claim: Twenty subjects each completed a task during functional imaging, giving an activation value in each of 1000 voxels, and each completed a personality questionnaire. Claim: in the population from which the subjects come, the 20 voxels whose activation is most strongly correlated with the questionnaire score have a mean correlation with that score of at least 0.5.

data_keys.meaning: task-related activation of each voxel in each subject
personality questionnaire score of each subject

claim: A nearest-neighbour regression (one neighbour, Euclidean distance on standardised measurements) of the value y on the measurements X predicts y for new entries with a mean absolute error at least 10% below that of predicting the mean of y: 1 - MAE(model) / MAE(mean predictor) >= 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: 8 continuous property measurements recorded for each registry entry
continuous target value recorded for each registry entry

claim: Each of 400 neurons was recorded on 40 trials before and on 40 trials after a manipulation. Claim: the proportion of neurons whose expected firing rate rises after the manipulation is larger among neurons whose expected pre-manipulation rate is below 8 Hz than among neurons whose expected pre-manipulation rate is at least 8 Hz, by at least 0.20.

data_keys.meaning: firing rate in Hz of each neuron on each trial before the manipulation
firing rate in Hz of each neuron on each trial after the manipulation

claim: Across cities, annual offences recorded and the median age of residents are associated after accounting for population: the partial correlation coefficient between offences and median age, given population, is at least 0.25 in absolute value.

data_keys.meaning: total offences recorded in each city in one year
median age of the residents of each city, in years
population of each city, in thousands

claim: 240 participants each received either a drug or a vehicle, and each was classified as a responder or not. Some participants carry a gene variant. Claim: the drug raises the proportion of responders more in carriers than in non-carriers, that is, the difference between the two drug-minus-vehicle differences in responder proportion (carriers minus non-carriers) is positive, judged by a one-sided test at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: True if the participant met the response criterion
True if the participant received the drug, False if the vehicle
True if the participant carries the gene variant

claim: The response of each of 1000 voxels was estimated on each of 60 trials, in which a stimulus of varying intensity was presented. Claim: in the population, the 25 voxels whose trial-by-trial response is most strongly correlated with stimulus intensity have a mean correlation with intensity of at least 0.25.

data_keys.meaning: estimated response amplitude of each voxel on each trial
stimulus intensity presented on each trial

claim: The daily driver measurements predict the daily river level in later days of the record: the root-mean-square error of the prediction is at most 0.70 standard deviations of the level.

data_keys.meaning: daily river level, in time order
daily measurements of the variables that may influence the river level, in time order

claim: A classifier built from the measured variables recognises both classes in new records: the balanced accuracy (the mean of sensitivity and specificity for the positive class) is at least 0.65.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the condition is present in the record

claim: Across patients, cardiac output explains at least 25% of the variance in systemic vascular resistance (R-squared of at least 0.25).

data_keys.meaning: mean arterial pressure of each patient, in mmHg
central venous pressure of each patient, in mmHg
cardiac output of each patient measured by thermodilution, in L/min
cardiac output of each patient measured by the Fick method from expired-gas oxygen uptake, in L/min
